items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: project-based-learning
items.summary: project-based-learning 是一个基于项目学习的教程合集，通过实际构建应用来掌握编程核心概念。区别于零散的语法教程，它提供从需求分析到实现、测试和部署的完整项目周期，覆盖 Python、JavaScript、Go 等多种语言。学习者可按难度选择项目，按步骤实践，从而积累真实开发经验。无论是初学者还是进阶者，都能从中找到合适项目，提升动手能力和问题解决技巧。
items.summary_en: A curated collection of project-based tutorials that teach programming by building real-world applications, solving the problem of abstract learning. Unlike passive lectures, these guides emphasize hands-on construction, covering languages like Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. Learners progress from simple toys to complex systems, gaining practical skills. Developers can choose a project matching their level, follow clear steps, and deploy results, making it ideal for self-taught programmers and bootcamp students seeking portfolio projects.

items.name: immich
items.summary: Immich 是一款高性能的自托管照片视频管理平台，解决了用户依赖谷歌相册等云服务的厂商锁定问题，让您完全掌控个人媒体库。它采用 TypeScript/Node.js 后端配合 Flutter 移动应用的技术架构，通过高效的媒体处理和跨设备同步机制，实现流畅的浏览和管理体验。您可以通过 Docker 在自有服务器上部署，使用移动应用自动备份照片，随时随地访问完整媒体库，享受完全私有的照片管理方案，非常适合注重数据隐私和想要摆脱云服务限制的用户实践自托管解决方案。
items.summary_en: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video management platform that solves the problem of vendor lock-in with cloud services like Google Photos by giving users complete control over their media library. It achieves high performance through a modern TypeScript/Node.js backend with Flutter mobile apps, enabling efficient media processing and smooth cross-device synchronization. You can deploy it on your own server using Docker, then use the mobile app to automatically backup photos while accessing your entire collection from any device with full privacy and no subscription fees.

items.name: meetily
items.summary: Meetily是一款本地运行的AI会议助手，采用Rust构建高性能管道，整合比标准Whisper快4倍的Parakeet模型实现实时语音转写，并支持说话人分离，最后通过Ollama本地模型生成会议摘要。在macOS或Windows上安装后，导入或录制会议音频即可获取带说话人标签的文字记录和精炼摘要。该工具无需云端处理，从源头杜绝数据外泄，特别适合对隐私敏感的远程团队、记者及法律从业者在离线环境中高效整理会议内容。
items.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that runs 100% locally, eliminating cloud dependency for sensitive conversations. Built on Rust, it leverages a 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper pipeline for live transcription and speaker diarization, with Ollama-powered summarization. This design ensures both speed and confidentiality. You can run it on macOS or Windows: simply install, point it to a meeting audio source, and receive real-time transcripts and concise summaries—ideal for remote teams, journalists, or anyone prioritizing data privacy.

items.name: unity-mcp
items.summary: Unity MCP 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）在 AI 助手与 Unity 编辑器之间搭建桥梁，让大语言模型能够管理资源、控制场景、编辑脚本并自动化工作流。其核心设计是利用 MCP 标准化 AI 与编辑器的交互，使集成更可扩展且健壮。技术亮点在于将 Unity 的脚本 API 封装为 MCP 工具，LLM 无需理解引擎细节即可调用。游戏开发者可接入 Claude、Gemini 等助手，自动执行批量材质替换、场景布局调整等重复任务，或构建理解上下文、辅助关卡设计的智能工具。
items.summary_en: Unity MCP bridges AI assistants with the Unity editor via the Model Context Protocol, enabling LLMs to manage assets, control scenes, edit scripts, and automate workflows. Its key strength lies in standardizing AI-Editor interactions through MCP, making integrations extensible and robust. Developers can connect tools like Claude or Gemini to Unity, automate repetitive tasks, or build intelligent game design assistants that understand context.

items.name: romm
items.summary: Romm 是一款自托管复古游戏 ROM 管理器和播放器，旨在解决游戏收藏混乱和无法统一播放的问题。它通过自动刮削元数据和封面图，让用户可以在美观的 Web 界面中浏览和启动游戏。其技术亮点是集成了基于浏览器的模拟器，无需额外配置即可直接运行。你可以利用 Docker 快速部署，导入 ROM 文件后即可拥有一个自带模拟功能的统一游戏库，非常适合复古游戏爱好者和收藏家。
items.summary_en: Romm is a self-hosted ROM manager and player that simplifies organizing and playing retro game collections. Its key technical insight is automatic metadata scraping and artwork fetching, combined with a web-based interface that launches games directly in the browser via integrated emulators. You can self-host it with Docker, import your ROM files, and instantly enjoy a unified, searchable library with built-in emulation—perfect for preserving and accessing classic games.

items.name: terax-ai
items.summary: Terax-ai 是一个仅7MB的终端优先AI原生开发工作台，将智能代理嵌入命令行，解决开发者频繁切换IDE和AI工具的效率问题。其技术亮点在于使用Tauri构建原生终端外壳，结合Xterm.js和React UI，使AI代理能实时感知命令执行过程，提供上下文相关的建议或自动完成重复任务。你可以直接替换现有终端，体验AI辅助的自动补全、命令解释和错误调试，或通过自定义插件扩展代理能力，实现个性化工作流自动化。
items.summary_en: Terax-ai is a lightweight (7MB) terminal-first AI-native development workspace that embeds intelligent agents directly into the command line, solving the problem of constant context switching between coding and AI assistants. Technically, it leverages Tauri for a native shell experience and a React-based UI inside the terminal (via Xterm.js), allowing AI agents to observe commands, output, and errors in real time to provide contextual suggestions and automations. Practically, developers can replace their existing terminal with Terax-ai to gain AI-powered autocomplete, error explanations, and the ability to create custom agent plugins for repetitive tasks.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.
items.summary_zh: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。

items.name: gemma-4-31B-it-FP8-block
items.summary: 这是 Google Gemma-4 31B 指令微调模型的 FP8 量化版本，目标是在保持生成质量的前提下大幅降低大模型推理的内存占用和延迟。通过 llm-compressor 的块状 FP8 量化技术，模型体积减半，配合 vLLM 等推理引擎可实现高效部署。适用于对话机器人、图文问答等实时场景，开发者可直接用 vLLM 或 transformers 加载，快速投入生产使用。
items.summary_en: This is an FP8 quantized version of Google's Gemma-4 31B instruction-tuned model, designed to reduce memory footprint and latency for large-scale inference while preserving output quality. Using block-wise FP8 quantization via llm-compressor, it roughly halves model size and supports efficient serving with vLLM. Ideal for chatbots, visual Q&A, and real-time applications, you can load it directly with vLLM or Hugging Face transformers for production deployment.

items.name: wav2vec2-base
items.summary: wav2vec2-base 是 Meta AI 推出的自监督语音表示模型，通过从无标签音频中学习通用语音特征，大幅降低了对人工标注转录的需求。其核心技术是使用对比学习与量化目标表示，让模型在无监督条件下自动捕捉音素级语言单元。实际应用中，你只需少量标注数据（如10分钟）微调，即可获得媲美全监督方案的语音识别性能；也可将其作为通用特征提取器，用于说话人验证、情感分析等下游任务。借助 Hugging Face Transformers 库，一行代码即可加载预训练权重并快速上手。
items.summary_en: wav2vec2-base is a self-supervised speech representation model from Meta AI that learns powerful audio features from unlabeled data, drastically reducing the need for transcribed speech. Its key innovation is contrastive learning with quantized target representations, enabling the model to capture phonetic units without supervision. You can fine-tune it on as little as 10 minutes of labeled speech for competitive automatic speech recognition, or extract general-purpose features for tasks like speaker verification or emotion recognition.

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
